nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values:
A wide cinematic anime illustration set on a dark coastal shallows at night.
A young woman walks away from the camera through ankle-deep seawater, positioned slightly left of center and large enough to remain the clear main character of the scene. The camera follows from behind at a natural standing height.
She has long, feminine, slightly wild hair reaching below her shoulders. The overall shape is soft and flowing, with uneven ends, loose strands, and a few lively outward flicks catching the sea breeze. Her hair feels naturally messy while still retaining an elegant silhouette.
She wears a plain white T-shirt and bright orange work coveralls. The coveralls are worn as trousers, with the upper body section pulled down completely and gathered around her hips. The empty sleeves are tied loosely around her waist, forming a natural knot and hanging folds of orange fabric around her hips.
Her right arm extends outward and gently downward as she carries a burning torch close to the water. The flame is substantial, energetic, and richly orange, with irregular tongues of fire and a few glowing sparks drifting upward. Warm firelight brushes across her right side, the edges of her hair, and the folds of the orange fabric.
The water around her is broad, dark, and glassy, broken only by scattered clusters of small coastal rocks. Large open patches of shallow water remain visible between them. The rocks vary naturally in shape and size, appearing in loose irregular groups rather than filling the entire ground.
The torchlight spreads across the wet surface in long fragmented reflections. Orange and golden light stretches through the black water in shimmering broken streaks, creating a mysterious, almost dreamlike glow around her footsteps. Small ripples distort the reflections into delicate shapes.
On the right side of the frame, very close to the camera, rests a weathered stranded fishing boat. It is an ordinary medium-sized working fishing boat seen from close range, making its visible hull feel large and imposing within the composition. The vessel lies heavily tilted across the shore, its body cutting diagonally through the right side of the image.
Only a portion of the fishing boat enters the frame. Its weathered hull, rusted metal, damaged cabin, broken windows, ropes, rails, and fragments of old equipment emerge from the darkness. The nearest surfaces receive a faint trace of warm torchlight, while the rest forms a massive dark silhouette at the edge of the scene.
A few pieces of debris rest naturally in the shallows: an old gasoline can, a crushed aluminum can, and several small fragments partially submerged in water. A tiny crab stands near one of the reflected streaks of firelight.
The distant coast dissolves into deep darkness, leaving the woman, the flame, the reflective water, and the looming fishing boat as the dominant visual shapes.
Stylized anime illustration, flat cel shading, clean expressive linework, bold simplified forms, painterly digital texture, cinematic perspective, dramatic use of darkness, luminous orange reflections, deep black and muted blue-green water, restrained colors, atmospheric depth, mysterious coastal mood, quiet tension, elegant composition.
